verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both crop the photo down to a strip of cat eyes and dog tongue, so neither animal can be recognised. The red pill shape that sat behind the quote is gone, which leaves the white headline sitting straight on the busy fur and the light dog coat, so it reads poorly. The yellow, red and purple shapes survive only as scattered slivers (one cut off at the right edge), and the layout is a cropped strip of the original rather than a banner redesigned to read left to right.
